text: I have my grandson tonight, he's 4. I took his temperature and it says 39.6, and that frightened me because I don't think he's been that hot before. I've got Calpol and Nurofen in the cupboard but I'm not sure how much I'm allowed to give him or if I can give both. I don't want to give him too much. His mum usually does all this and I'm worried I'll get it wrong.
